description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SerializationConstructorNotFoundException' used in the Orleans.Serialization namespace, indicating a missing serialization constructor for a type.

classes.name: SerializationConstructorNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception thrown when a type lacks a serialization constructor.

methods.name: SerializationConstructorNotFoundException(Type type)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating the missing serialization constructor for the specified type.

methods.description: Protected constructor used during deserialization of the exception object.
